summary: Full-stack testing (backend pytest + frontend playwright) for Leverage What Matters MVP. 17/17 backend tests pass covering auth (register/login/refresh/logout, duplicate+wrong-password, me unauth), analyses CRUD, items/experiments/learnings CRUD, user isolation (B cannot access A's analysis -> 404 for GET/PATCH/DELETE/add-item), and guide message listing. Frontend verified: home with 8 method-step testids, About philosophy statement/quote, protected-route redirect to /signin, signup -> /dashboard, signin wrong-password shows auth-error, create analysis -> workspace, focus-question save, add in_scope item, stage tab navigation (focus/see/decide/learn), system-map visible, experiment dialog + save, guide message streaming works (returned labelled YOU TOLD ME / I'M WONDERING / WE DON'T KNOW YET / QUESTION blocks + 3 proposals rendered), signout via user-menu, mobile 390px nav-mobile-toggle + guide-open-btn/guide-close-btn full-screen panel, tablet 768px layout OK.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_auth.login: brute-force counter is reset to a fresh 15-min lockout on EVERY failed attempt (sets locked_until each time) even if attempts < MAX_ATTEMPTS. That's fine, but delete_login_attempts on success means attackers can never trigger lockout alternating with another IP+email identifier (identifier includes IP+email so this is OK). The locked_until comparison uses string ISO comparison which only works because both are ISO-8601 UTC with same offset format -- fragile. Consider parsing to datetime.

accept_proposal response returns both analysis and message; good. But proposal 'known' from guide becomes item with source='guide'; UI should surface 'Proposed by the Guide' marker -- verified visually.
routes_guide.send_message: inserts user_msg BEFORE verifying LLM success. If LLM throws, the user message persists but no assistant reply -- acceptable but could leave orphaned turns.
No rate-limiting on /api/analyses/{id}/guide/messages -- a user could spam the LLM. Consider per-user quota.

Expected data-testid 'guide-start-btn' is only shown when no history exists; when history exists only 'guide-input' is present. Test matrix says 'guide-start-btn or guide-input + guide-send-btn' so both are acceptable paths.

Dashboard row has data-testid='analysis-row-{id}' on <li> but navigation uses inner <Link data-testid='open-analysis-{id}'>; main agent should ensure tests/users click the Link, not the row. Not a bug.
test_credentials: demo@leveragewhatmatters.com / Leverage8! (verified). Also created TEST_fe_* and TEST_a/b_* users during tests.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create and delete their own TEST_* users and TEST_* analyses. Did not clean test users from users collection (safe since prefixed TEST_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs cleanly in ~4s via pytest-xdist. Google OAuth path was NOT exercised end-to-end (requires real session_id from Emergent service); backend session cookie code path is covered by _session_user_id but not integration-tested. Guide SSE streaming is covered implicitly via the frontend playwright test which observed a full labelled reply and 3 proposals; no direct SSE pytest. The demo account auto-seeded analysis 'Team stalls' is reused for guide testing.
